title: Unified archive preview surface
description:
Add `jit archive document <path>` and `jit archive container <id>` as non-mutating preview-by-default commands backed by the shared artifact planner. Both run every execution precondition: source availability, explicit complete policy, terminal eligibility, repository-wide ownership, pinned resolution/read semantics, destination conflicts, supported-edge reachability, symlink blockers, dynamic-loading warnings, and action classification. Render the binding schema-version-1 envelope under `--json` and an equivalent human view.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Preview lists every artifact, action, evidence flag, warning, and blocker while producing no filesystem, issue, or event mutation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Document and container targets produce the same plan schema through the same planner, and human output conveys the same decisions as JSON.
- [hard] REQ-03: Missing or partial `[documentation]` policy produces a non-mutating inventory that distinctly reports `unconfigured` or `incomplete`, explains that archival execution is disabled, and never substitutes defaults to claim eligibility.
- [hard] REQ-04: Fixture tests for Markdown, HTML, CSS, CSV, PNG, and SVG roots and bundles produce schema-version-1 previews with deterministic artifact/action/blocker results, and each human rendering represents the same plan as its JSON rendering.
